entries.title: Firstmate no longer shows a choice that fails because its task is closed
entries.body: Firstmate could put up a decision about a task that had already closed, such as one offering to build something a finished prototype explored. Every button on it then failed with "Its task is no longer open." Firstmate now asks such a question as a new decision, or about a new follow-up task, so its buttons work.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears: a card whose buttons could not work no longer shows up, and the one that replaces it looks like any decision.
